_meta.source: Seeded from the 28 exercise names referenced by the 7 surviving Firestore workout templates, merged with the 10 real docs from the 2019 `exercises` collection. Duplicates collapsed into aliases.
review_required: skill_demand — my draft. You know where the real coaching burden is.
joint_stress — my draft. This is the safety-critical field; every value should get your eyes.
viable_reps — my draft. Check the ones you program often.
cue — intentionally left empty on every entry. This is your voice, not mine.
additions: power-clean and barbell-shrug were not in your data. Added because the decomposition design depends on that example.
barbell-bent-over-row and pull-up added to anchor days 4 and 6 of the six-day strength split — the library had no primary horizontal_pull or vertical_pull.
dumbbell-shoulder-press, reverse-lunge and lateral-raise added after the week generator reported empty accessory lunge and accessory vertical_push slots.
16 exercises added from the lifter's current program (Oct 2026).
notes: Arm isolations carry the pattern of the chain they assist (curl -> vertical_pull, tricep extension -> horizontal_push). role='isolation' keeps them from ever being offered as a swap for a compound.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.setup: Bar on the upper traps, feet about shoulder width, brace before descending.

exercises.name: Barbell Front Squat
exercises.setup: Bar in the front rack, elbows high, torso upright through the descent.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.setup: Hold one dumbbell at the chest in both hands, squat between the knees.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.setup: Feet mid-platform, lower until the knees reach about ninety degrees.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.setup: Rear foot on a box or bench, lunge down to parallel.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.setup: Bar over mid-foot, brace, push the floor away.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.setup: Wide stance, hands inside the knees, hips closer to the bar.

exercises.name: Deficit Deadlift
exercises.setup: Stand on a one to two inch platform, pull from the extended range.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Deadlift
exercises.setup: Kettlebell between the feet, hinge back, stand tall.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.setup: Shoulder blades retracted, bar to the lower chest, feet planted.

exercises.name: Flat Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.setup: Dumbbells at chest width, press without clashing at the top.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.setup: Bench at thirty to forty-five degrees, press over the collarbone.

exercises.name: Alternating Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.setup: Hold one dumbbell up while pressing the other. Alternate each rep.

exercises.name: Narrow Grip Bench Press
exercises.setup: Hands about shoulder width, elbows tracking close to the ribs.

exercises.name: Diamond Pushup
exercises.setup: Hands together under the sternum, body in one line.

exercises.name: Military Press
exercises.setup: Bar at the collarbone, ribs down, press and finish with the head through.

exercises.name: Side Press
exercises.setup: Press one bell overhead while the torso leans away from the working side.

exercises.name: Cable Lat Pulldown
exercises.setup: Chest tall, drive the elbows down rather than pulling with the hands.

exercises.name: Straight Arm Pulldown
exercises.setup: Arms long, sweep the bar to the thighs without bending the elbows.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.setup: Torso upright, pull to the navel, control the return.

exercises.name: Single Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.setup: One hand and knee on the bench, row to the hip, square the shoulders.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
exercises.setup: Bar at arms length, elevate the shoulders straight up, no rolling.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
exercises.setup: Elbows pinned to the ribs, curl without swinging the torso.

exercises.name: Tricep Cable Extension
exercises.setup: Elbows fixed at the sides, extend to lockout, control the return.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.setup: Balls of the feet on the platform, full stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.setup: Pad above the ankle, extend to lockout without slamming.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curl
exercises.setup: Pad at the achilles, curl to full contraction, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.setup: Seated, heels off the floor, rotate the ribcage rather than the arms.

exercises.name: Leg Raise
exercises.setup: Lower back stays flat, raise the legs without swinging.

exercises.name: V-Up
exercises.setup: Legs and torso rise together to meet over the hips.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.setup: Plank position, drive the knees alternately without the hips rising.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Slam
exercises.setup: Ball overhead, slam through the floor, absorb with the hips.

exercises.name: Treadmill Intervals
exercises.setup: Alternate work and recovery intervals at a fixed incline.

exercises.name: Power Clean
exercises.setup: Pull from the floor, extend the hips violently, receive in a quarter squat.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent Over Row
exercises.setup: Hinge to roughly forty-five degrees, row to the lower ribs, hold the torso angle.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.setup: Full hang to chin over the bar. Add external load once bodyweight sets top the range.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.setup: Seated with back support, press from ear height to lockout.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.setup: Step back to a knee-touch, drive through the front heel to stand.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.setup: Raise to shoulder height with a soft elbow, lead with the elbow not the hand.

exercises.name: Dip
exercises.setup: Slight forward lean for chest, lower to a shoulder-safe depth.

exercises.name: Chest Fly
exercises.setup: Soft elbows, arc the hands together, control the stretch.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.setup: Start palms in at the chin, rotate out as you press.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Row
exercises.setup: Chest on the pad, drive the elbows back.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Lat Pulldown
exercises.setup: Pull the elbows to the ribs, control the return.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.setup: Arms long, sweep out to the sides, no shrug.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.setup: Feet low and narrow for quads, full depth.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press Machine
exercises.setup: Handles at ear height, press to lockout.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Press
exercises.setup: Bench at thirty degrees, bar to the upper chest.

exercises.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.setup: Legs locked in, bar to the lower chest.

exercises.name: Bicep Machine Curl
exercises.setup: Upper arm flat on the pad, full extension at the bottom.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
exercises.setup: Neutral grip, elbows pinned, no swing.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.setup: Lower to the forehead or just behind, elbows stay pointed up.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust Machine
exercises.setup: Chin tucked, ribs down, full lockout with a squeeze.

exercises.name: Belt Squat
exercises.setup: Torso upright, sit straight down between the heels.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.setup: Soft knees, push the hips back until the hamstrings stop you.
